title: Abbas Zindabad
body:
AS SALAAM ALAIKA YA ABUL FAZLIL ABBAS YABNA ALI
ABBAS ZINDABAD (X3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehra bhi haideri hai awaz haideri hai
Har rukh se bawafa ka andaz haideri hai
Hai maut jisko pyari hamla karega is par
Wo dekho aa raha hai wo dekho shere haider
ABBAS ZINDABAD (X3)
<<DIVIDER>>

Wo dekho aa raha hai wo dekho shere haider
